message.content:
The most visited market in New York City is **Union Square Greenmarket**.  
It draws roughly 1.5 million visitors each year, making it the largest and most popular farmers‑market in the city. The market operates Monday–Saturday (closed on Sundays) and offers a wide variety of fresh produce, artisanal foods, and local products from over 200 vendors. Its central location, extensive product selection, and frequent events (e.g., cooking demos, live music) contribute to its high foot traffic and popularity among both locals and tourists.
